40: - AP/CP 共享 Wi-Fi buffer 的地址校验、生命周期和 cache 处理。
41: - NuttX `netdev_lowerhalf` Wi-Fi 网卡 `wlan0`。

56:           │ CP→AP CMD/DATA 0x44/0x45
57:           │ MBOX0 + 共享 SRAM pointer/list
58:           ▼
59: CPU0/Armino CP，保持原样
60:   ├─ controller_if/cif
61:   ├─ Wi-Fi command/event handler
62:   ├─ RWNX/FHOST/UMAC/LMAC
63:   ├─ WPA/关联控制
64:   └─ Wi-Fi MAC/PHY/RF
65: ```
66: 
67: 本方案中：
68: 
69: - CPU0 是 CP，不是 OpenVela AP。
70: - CPU1 是当前 OpenVela AP primary，也是唯一启用的 AP CPU。
71: - CPU2 保持当前单核 bring-up 状态，不参与 Wi-Fi ISR、worker 或共享 buffer 管理。
72: - CP 是 Wi-Fi radio/controller 的唯一所有者。
73: - NuttX 是 AP 网络协议栈的所有者。
74: - 第一版采用 copy 接入 NuttX `netpkt_t`，不追求 NuttX packet 与 CP pbuf 零拷贝。
75: 
76: ### 1.3 本轮明确不采用的方案
77: 
78: - 不修改 CP，增加新的 Ethernet bridge 或新 ring 协议。
79: - 不把 CP Wi-Fi/RWNX 静态库链接进 OpenVela AP。
80: - 不让 OpenVela AP直接访问 Wi-Fi MAC/PHY/RF 寄存器。
81: - 不在 AP 内同时运行 Armino lwIP 和 NuttX 网络栈。
82: - 不通过 socket RPC 把全部 socket 操作代理到 CP。
83: - 不改变原厂 `MB_CHNL_WIFI_CMD`、`MB_CHNL_WIFI_DATA` 编号和 command ID。
84: - 不在第一阶段启用 SoftAP、P2P、monitor、raw link、CSI、FTM 或零拷贝。
85: - 不在第一阶段启用 CPU2 SMP。

425: 实现语义必须与原厂一致：
426: 
427: - channel 值越小，物理调度优先级越高。
428: - 每个 logical command 都写入递增 `tx_seq`。

434: ### 4.3 Wi-Fi command transport
435: 
436: AP command 路径：
437: 
438: ```text
439: wireless_ops/ioctl
440:   -> bk7258_wifi_control_request()
441:   -> 分配 command buffer
442:   -> 填写 cmd_id/cmd_sn/payload
443:   -> cpdu_t header
444:   -> ipc_chnl_node_t(head=tail, num=1, channel=TX_BK_CMD_DATA)
445:   -> MB_CHNL_WIFI_CMD 0x14
446:   -> transport ACK
447:   -> CP command confirmation 0x44
448:   -> 按 cmd_id + sequence 唤醒等待者
449: ```
450: 
451: 必须区分：
452: 
453: - transport ACK：CP 已接管 `ipc_chnl_node_t`。
454: - command confirmation：CP 已执行业务命令并返回结果。
455: 
456: 控制请求使用 NuttX mutex + semaphore，要求：
457: 
458: - 每个请求有有界 timeout。
459: - timeout 后从 pending list 删除。
460: - CP/AP reset 时全部 pending request 返回 `-ECONNRESET`。
461: - 迟到 confirmation 只计数，不访问已释放 request。
462: - 不能在 Mailbox ISR 中阻塞。
463: 
464: ### 4.4 Wi-Fi TX 数据面
465: 
466: 由于 CP 不修改，CP 仍要求 Beken `pbuf/cpdu_t` 兼容布局。第一版在 AP 定义最小 wire-compatible TX allocation，不把 lwIP 协议栈带入 NuttX：
467: 
468: ```text
469: [wire pbuf-compatible metadata][cpdu_t][Ethernet frame]
470: ```
471: 
472: 是否必须完整复制原厂 `struct pbuf`，必须通过 CP `cif_handle_txdata()` 和实际编译配置确认。不能凭 `cpdu_t` 单独推断。正式编码前要固定：
473: 
474: - `sizeof(struct pbuf)`。
475: - payload 指针相对 pbuf/cpdu 的布局。
476: - `CONFIG_CONTROLLER_AP_BUFFER_COPY` 最终值。
477: - CP 是否修改 pbuf refcount、flags、next 和 payload。
478: - TX completion 是通过反向 `need_free` packet 还是 command confirmation。
479: 
480: 当前 `app_ab` direct-push 基线已经显示，CP 的 `cif_handle_txdata()` 会用 `head - sizeof(struct pbuf)` 还原并直接访问 AP 创建的 `struct pbuf`；TX 完成时 `cif_free_ap_txbuf()` 把同一对象的 `need_free` 置 1，再通过 CP→AP `WIFI_DATA 0x45` 返回。因此 W3 不是只兼容一个抽象的“pbuf-like metadata”，而是必须冻结并复现该最终构建所使用的完整 lwIP `struct pbuf` ABI，包括字段大小、顺序、对齐、payload 指针、refcount 和 `pbuf + 1 == cpdu` 布局。若无法证明 NuttX AP RAM 地址可被 CP 直接访问，或者无法安全复现该 ABI，则“不修改 CP”的 W1 数据面方案被阻断；不得继续靠猜测实现。
481: 
482: 依据：
483: 
484: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_wifi_dp.c:138-179`
485: - `bk_avdk_smp/cp/components/controller_if/cif_mem_mgmt.c:8-24`
486: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi_driver/wdrv_tx.c:49-111`
487: 
488: TX 路径：
489: 
490: ```text
491: NuttX transmit(netpkt)
492:   -> 从 AP Wi-Fi TX pool 取对象
493:   -> netpkt_copyout() 到兼容 Ethernet payload
494:   -> 设置 cpdu.length/type/vif/need_free
495:   -> 保存 netpkt 和 shared object 的 pending 关系
496:   -> MB_CHNL_WIFI_DATA
497:   -> CP 接管并发往 Wi-Fi
498:   -> CP 返回 TX completion/free indication
499:   -> 释放 shared object 和 netpkt
500:   -> netdev_lower_txdone()
501: ```
502: 
503: `transmit()` 必须遵守：
504: 
505: - `openvela/nuttx/include/nuttx/net/netdev_lowerhalf.h:159-169`
506: 
507: 返回 `OK` 后 driver 已接管 `netpkt`，必须在完成路径释放；返回负 errno 时由 upper half 回收。
508: 
509: 第一版必须 copy，不能把 NuttX heap pointer 或 `netpkt_t *` 直接发送给 CP。
510: 
511: ### 4.5 Wi-Fi RX 数据面
512: 
513: CP→AP `ipc_chnl_node_t` 到达后：
514: 
515: 1. Mailbox ISR 复制 CP→AP `WIFI_DATA 0x45` 的 16-byte node，只做不需要解引用远端 pointer 的 `channel/num` 基础检查并投递 RX worker。
516: 2. RX worker 校验 `head/tail` 地址窗口和对齐。
517: 3. RX worker 按 `num` 遍历 CP 链，每一步校验 pointer、最小 header、length、next 和是否循环。
518: 4. RX worker为合法 frame分配 `NETPKT_RX` 并复制 Ethernet frame。
519: 5. 无论复制成功、队列满还是帧被拒绝，都必须按冻结后的所有权协议决定回收、暂缓或触发 channel reset；不能既丢 descriptor 又不归还 CP buffer。
520: 6. 按原厂协议向 CP 返回 free/recycle indication；该方向使用 AP→CP `WIFI_DATA 0x15`，具体 `need_free`/buffer-bank 状态必须在 W0 trace 中冻结。
521: 7. 调用 `netdev_lower_rxready()`；`receive()` 返回准备好的 packet。
522: 
523: 禁止在 Mailbox ISR 中：
524: 
525: - 调用完整 NuttX IP input。
526: - 动态执行复杂 command handler。
527: - 等待 semaphore。
528: - 递归发送大量 free message。
529: - 直接释放 CP heap pointer。
530: 
531: 原 AP 的 RX 逻辑参考：
532: 
533: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi_driver/wdrv_rx.c:72-149`
534: - `bk_avdk_smp/ap/components/bk_wifi_driver/wdrv_rx.c:152-207`
535: 
536: ### 4.6 跨核 pointer 校验
537: 
538: W1 必须接受原厂 CP 指针协议，但每次解引用前都要校验。至少包括：
539: 
540: - pointer 4-byte 对齐。
541: - pointer 位于允许的 CP RAM/PSRAM shared window。
542: - `length` 不小于 header，不超过协商的最大 frame。
543: - `num` 不超过固定上限。
544: - `next` 每次都位于允许窗口。
545: - 链表实际节点数不超过 `num`。
546: - 最后节点和 `tail` 一致。
547: - 地址加长度无 32-bit overflow。
548: - 同一地址不能在当前 ownership table 中重复出现。
549: - reset epoch 后不接受旧 transaction 中的 pointer。
550: 
551: 当前 `CP_RAM_START/END` 硬编码只能作为 bring-up 值：
552: 
553: - `contest/.../bk7258_mailbox_channel.c:33-34`
554: 
555: 正式实现应由目标分区生成结果导出 shared window，不能在 Wi-Fi driver 再复制一组常量。
556: 
557: ### 4.7 Cache 和内存属性
558: 
559: 首版要求 Wi-Fi shared pool 位于双方都可访问的 non-cacheable、shareable 区域。若无法做到，所有权交接必须按以下顺序：
560: 
561: 发送端：
562: 
563: ```text
564: 写 payload
565: 写 descriptor/header
566: clean payload cache
567: clean descriptor cache
568: DMB
569: 发送 mailbox doorbell
570: ```
571: 
572: 接收端：
573: 
574: ```text
575: 收到 mailbox
576: invalidate descriptor cache
577: 读取并校验 descriptor
578: invalidate payload cache
579: 读取 payload
580: 处理完成后 clean ownership/completion
581: DMB
582: 发送 ACK/free indication
583: ```
584: 
585: `volatile` 和 `dmb sy` 不能替代 cache maintenance。
586: 
587: ### 4.8 Reset 和恢复
588: 
589: 不修改 CP 意味着不能给 CP wire descriptor增加新 epoch 字段，因此 AP 必须在本地维护 transport generation，并使用原厂 logical channel reset 行为完成重同步：
590: 
591: ```text
592: 检测 CP reset/channel reset/heartbeat failure
593:   -> carrier off
594:   -> 阻止新 TX
595:   -> 所有 control request 返回 -ECONNRESET
596:   -> 回收 AP 自有 TX packet
597:   -> 丢弃尚未交给 NuttX 的 CP RX descriptor
598:   -> 清理 channel active/pending/ACK queue
599:   -> 重新 open WIFI_CMD/WIFI_DATA
600:   -> 重新获取 MAC/status
601:   -> 恢复 STA config
602:   -> 重新连接
603:   -> 收到 connected event 后 carrier on
604: ```
605: 
606: 由于 CP 协议本身没有 generation，旧 CP pointer 的安全回收能力有限。这是 W1 在“不修改 CP”约束下的固有风险，必须通过 reset 时 FIFO drain、channel reset 和 ownership table 清空降低风险。
607: 
608: ## 5. NuttX 网络接入
609: 
610: ### 5.1 netdev lower-half
611: 
612: 实现：
613: 
614: ```c
615: static int bk7258_wlan_ifup(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *dev);
616: static int bk7258_wlan_ifdown(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *dev);
617: static int bk7258_wlan_transmit(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *dev,
618:                                 netpkt_t *pkt);
619: static netpkt_t *bk7258_wlan_receive(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *dev);
620: static void bk7258_wlan_reclaim(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *dev);
621: ```
622: 
623: NuttX接口依据：
624: 
625: - `openvela/nuttx/include/nuttx/net/netdev_lowerhalf.h:117-192`
626: - `openvela/nuttx/include/nuttx/net/netdev_lowerhalf.h:267-354`
627: 
628: BK7236N 参考只用于 NuttX 接口形态：
629: 
630: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_wlan.c:54-123`
631: - `vendor_beken/chips/bk7236n/beken_wlan.c:167-303`
632: 
633: 不得直接复用其 `bk_wifi_send_tx_eth()` 等单核接口。
634: 
635: ### 5.2 carrier 语义
636: 
637: `ifup()` 只表示 driver 启动成功，不表示 STA 已关联。正确语义：
638: 
639: ```text
640: ifup
641:   -> transport ready
642:   -> STA_START/启用控制面
643:   -> 保持 carrier off
644: 
645: CP STA_CONNECTED event
646:   -> netdev_lower_carrier_on()
647: 
648: CP STA_DISCONNECTED event
649:   -> netdev_lower_carrier_off()
650: ```
651: 
652: 不要照搬 BK7236N 在 `ifup()` 后立即 carrier-on 的行为。
653: 
654: ### 5.3 wireless handlers
655: 
656: 启用 `CONFIG_NETDEV_WIRELESS_HANDLER` 后实现：
657: 
658: - `connect`
659: - `disconnect`
660: - `essid`
661: - `passwd`
662: - `auth`
663: - `country`
664: - `scan`
665: - 必要的 `range`
666: 
667: 接口：
668: 
669: - `openvela/nuttx/include/nuttx/net/netdev_lowerhalf.h:194-231`
670: 
671: 第一版可以将 BSSID、bitrate、txpower 等不支持项留空或返回 `-ENOTSUP`，不能伪造成功。
672: 
673: ### 5.4 网络栈所有权
674: 
675: 正式目标是 NuttX 作为 AP IP 栈。必须核对 CP `cif_wifi_dp` 对 ARP、IPv4、IPv6 和广播包的过滤逻辑，确保 AP 获得完整 Ethernet 流量。若 CP 仍消费 DHCP/ARP 或只转发特定业务包，`wlan0` 无法成为透明接口。
676: 
677: 在不修改 CP 的前提下，应优先使用原 AVDK AP 对应配置下已经启用的“AP host owns network”模式。必须从 CP 最终 `sdkconfig.h` 固定并记录：
678: 
679: - `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_CONTROLLER`
680: - `CONFIG_WIFI_CP_IPC` 的最终值，并记录它在当前源码中不负责守卫 `cif_init()`。
681: - `CONFIG_CONTROLLER_AP_BUFFER_COPY`
682: - RX direct-push/filter 相关配置
683: - CP lwIP 是否保留本地 IP
684: 
685: 当前 `app_ab` 生成配置已经确认：
686: 
687: ```text
688: CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_CONTROLLER=y
689: CONFIG_CONTROLLER_AP_BUFFER_COPY=n
690: CONFIG_CONTROLLER_RX_DIRECT_PSH=y
691: ```
692: 
693: 依据：
694: 
695: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/config/sdkconfig.h:124-129`
696: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258/config/sdkconfig.cmake:256`
697: - `bk_avdk_smp/projects/app_ab/build/bk7258/app_ab/bk7258_ap/config/sdkconfig.h:153-154`
698: 
699: 这意味着当前基线优先走原厂 direct-push/共享 pbuf 所有权路径，而不是 CP copy adapter。OpenVela W1 必须兼容该路径，不能假定 CP 会在收到 NuttX frame 后自动复制到自己的 pbuf。
700: 
701: 如果原 CP 配置不能向 AP 提供完整 Ethernet frame，本轮“不修改 CP”的目标将被阻断，不能通过 AP 侧猜测绕过。

756: ## 7. 实施步骤
757: 
758: ### 阶段 W0：冻结原厂 wire ABI
759: 
760: 完成以下输出物：
761: 
762: - AP/CP channel ID 对照表。
763: - `ipc_chnl_node_t`、`cpdu_t`、`common_header` 以及最终 lwIP `struct pbuf` 的 `sizeof/offsetof/alignment`。
764: - AP TX 对象满足 `pbuf + 1 == cpdu`、payload/refcount/next 字段语义的双工具链 ABI 验证。
765: - 最终 CP `sdkconfig.h` 中 buffer-copy 和 VNET 配置。
766: - command、confirmation 和 event header 格式。
767: - TX completion、RX release 和 `need_free` 的状态图。
768: - AP_RAM、CP_RAM、PWR_MNG、SWAP、PSRAM 的双方可见地址窗口。
769: - golden AVDK AP/CP 的 Mailbox trace。
770: 
771: 未完成这些项目不得开始数据面编码。
772: 
773: ### 阶段 W1：通用 logical channel
774: 
775: 实现并验证：
776: 
777: - AP TX/RX `0x14/0x44`。
778: - AP TX/RX `0x15/0x45`。
779: - open/close/write/control。
780: - RX callback。
781: - TX-complete callback。
782: - ACK queue。
783: - timeout/reset completion。
784: - 统计查询。
785: 
786: 验收：每个通道双向 10,000 次 command/ACK，无永久 busy、ACK 覆盖和 sequence 错配。
787: 
788: ### 阶段 W2：Wi-Fi 控制面
789: 
790: 按顺序实现：
791: 
792: 1. transport/channel ready。
793: 2. `STA_GET_MAC`。
794: 3. `GET_STATUS`。
795: 4. `WIFI_GET_COUNTRY/WIFI_SET_COUNTRY`。
796: 5. `SCAN_START/SCAN_RESULT/SCAN_RESULT_FREE`。
797: 6. `STA_SET_CONFIG`。
798: 7. `STA_START/STA_STOP`。
799: 8. connected/disconnected event。
800: 
801: 此阶段不注册 `wlan0` 数据面也可以完成。验收包括扫描、设置 SSID/密码、关联和断开。
802: 
803: ### 阶段 W3：NuttX `wlan0` 和 TX
804: 
805: 实现：
806: 
807: - `netdev_lower_register(..., NET_LL_ETHERNET)`。
808: - MAC address 设置。
809: - TX pool。
810: - `netpkt_copyout()`。
811: - CP pbuf/cpdu wire-compatible object。
812: - TX completion/free。
813: - `netdev_lower_txdone()`。
814: 
815: 先发送 ARP/ICMP 小包，再验证 MTU 边界和 fragmented `netpkt`。
816: 
817: ### 阶段 W4：RX
818: 
819: 实现：
820: 
821: - CP node/list 校验。
822: - RX worker。
823: - `netpkt_alloc/copyin()`。
824: - CP buffer release。
825: - `netdev_lower_rxready()`。
826: - RX queue backpressure。
827: 
828: 验收：ARP、DHCP 和 ping。
829: 
830: ### 阶段 W5：完整网络功能
831: 
832: 依次验证：
833: 
834: - DHCP renew。
835: - DNS。
836: - TCP client/server。
837: - UDP。
838: - IPv6/NDP。
839: - Wi-Fi断线重连。
840: - AP复位和CP复位恢复。
841: - OTA 使用路径，但不直接擦写 Flash。
842: 
843: ### 阶段 W6：稳定性和性能
844: 
845: 验证：
846: 
847: - 72 小时联网。
848: - TCP/UDP并发。
849: - burst RX/TX。
850: - Mailbox日志、heartbeat、PWC 和 Wi-Fi并发。
851: - buffer pool耗尽和恢复。
852: - 网络压力下无 heartbeat timeout。
853: - CPU1 单核负载和栈水位。
854: 
855: 零拷贝、descriptor ring 和 CPU2 SMP 不属于该阶段。
856: 
857: ## 8. 测试和门禁
858: 
859: ### 8.1 Transport 门禁
860: 
861: - Wi-Fi CMD/DATA 双向各 10,000 次。
862: - FIFO full 可自动恢复。
863: - transport ACK 与 command confirmation 不混淆。
864: - bad source、bad pointer、bad length、bad list、循环 list 全部拒绝。
865: - timeout 后 channel 不永久 busy。
866: - AP/CP reset 后可以重新 open。
867: 
868: ### 8.2 控制面门禁
869: 
870: - 连续扫描 100 次无泄漏。
871: - 连接正确密码成功。
872: - 错误密码返回明确失败原因。
873: - 断线 event 驱动 carrier off。
874: - 重新连接不复用旧 confirmation。
875: - SSID/password 不出现在普通日志中。
876: 
877: ### 8.3 数据面门禁
878: 
879: - DHCP 成功。
880: - ping gateway 和公网地址成功。
881: - DNS 成功。
882: - TCP/UDP 双向正常。
883: - 64、512、1500 字节 Ethernet frame 正常。
884: - TX pool耗尽返回 backpressure，不覆盖 buffer。
885: - RX queue满时按明确策略丢包并计数。
886: - AP/CP reset 后没有 double free 或旧 pointer 解引用。
887: 
888: ### 8.4 性能基线
889: 
890: 第一版不规定等同原 AVDK 的吞吐，但必须记录：
891: 
892: - TCP uplink/downlink。
893: - UDP uplink/downlink 和丢包率。
894: - Wi-Fi TX/RX copy 次数。
895: - 每包 Mailbox 数量。
896: - AP CPU 使用率。
897: - RX/TX queue峰值。
898: - buffer pool 最低空闲数。
899: 
900: ## 9. 故障定位顺序
901: 
902: ### Wi-Fi command无响应
903: 
904: 1. 确认 CP 最终配置启用 `CONFIG_WIFI_VNET_CONTROLLER`。
905: 2. 确认 AP TX `0x14` 已 open，CP→AP `0x44` 未被 AP RX 白名单拒绝。
906: 3. 检查 transport ACK channel/sequence。
907: 4. 检查 command `cmd_id/cmd_sn`。
908: 5. 检查 CP pointer窗口和 command buffer布局。
909: 6. 检查 confirmation ID 和 sequence。
910: 
911: ### 已关联但无 DHCP
912: 
913: 1. 确认 carrier 只在 connected event 后打开。
914: 2. 确认 AP 收到广播、ARP 和 DHCP frame。
915: 3. 检查 CP filter 是否仍把流量留给 CP lwIP。
916: 4. 检查 Ethernet header 是否完整。
917: 5. 检查 RX release是否过早。
918: 6. 检查 NuttX netdev link type。
919: 
920: ### TX 卡死
921: 
922: 1. 检查 logical TX-complete是否到达。
923: 2. 区分 transport ACK 和 Wi-Fi TX completion。
924: 3. 检查 `sending_flag` 或 NuttX pending table。
925: 4. 检查 CP 是否等待错误的 pbuf/cpdu布局。
926: 5. 检查 buffer ownership和 `need_free`。
927: 6. 检查 FIFO full后 ACK queue是否丢失。
928: 
929: ### 随机数据损坏
930: 
931: 1. 检查 pointer窗口。
932: 2. 检查 `sizeof/offsetof/packing`。
933: 3. 检查 cache clean/invalidate。
934: 4. 检查 AP 是否在 CP 完成前复用 TX buffer。
935: 5. 检查 CP RX buffer是否在 NuttX copy完成前释放。
936: 6. 检查 reset后旧 descriptor。
937: 
938: ## 10. 风险和待确认事项
939: 
940: ### 10.1 不修改 CP 的固有限制
941: 
942: - Wire ABI 包含 32-bit pointer 和 Beken pbuf布局，不是独立于 OS 的稳定协议。
943: - CP 无 protocol version/epoch，跨版本和 reset 恢复能力有限。
944: - 数据面是否能向 NuttX 提供完整 Ethernet frame 取决于 CP 最终 VNET/filter 配置。
945: - CP/AP 共享 PSRAM 和 cache属性需要原厂资料或实测确认。
946: - 原厂 W1 的 ownership代码包含大量历史分支，必须以最终配置裁剪状态为准。
947: 
948: ### 10.2 量产前必须确认
949: 
950: - CP Wi-Fi IPC ABI 是否承诺版本稳定。
951: - shared pointer允许窗口和 DMA master访问属性。
952: - cache line、clean/invalidate语义和 barrier要求。
953: - CP reset时 Wi-Fi buffer回收规则。
954: - WPA密钥和凭据跨核传输的安全边界。
955: - AP/CP网络栈所有权和低功耗唤醒职责。
956: 
957: ## 11. 完成定义
958: 
959: 满足以下条件才算完成 BK7258 OpenVela AP 单核 Wi-Fi W1 移植：
960: 
961: - CPU0/CP 固件未修改。
962: - CPU1/OpenVela 单核持续正常运行，CPU2未作为依赖。
963: - 原厂 AP→CP `0x14/0x15`、CP→AP `0x44/0x45` 协议兼容。
964: - logical channel具备 RX、TX-complete、ACK queue、timeout和reset恢复。
965: - `wlan0` 注册为 NuttX netdev。
966: - 扫描、连接、断开和状态查询正常。
967: - NuttX拥有 IP、DHCP、DNS、TCP/UDP 数据面。
968: - Wi-Fi TX/RX buffer无覆盖、泄漏、double free和越界访问。
969: - AP/CP任一侧复位后可恢复网络。
970: - Wi-Fi压力不破坏 heartbeat、PWC和Mailbox UART日志。
971: - 所有协议结构和最终 CP 配置已记录，构建可重复。
972: 
973: CPU2 SMP、SoftAP、P2P、monitor、CSI、FTM、零拷贝和高性能 descriptor ring 是后续工作，不属于本文完成定义。

428:     {

433:         }

448:             }

475:       active->arg = channel->arg;

523: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
524: {
525:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
526:   struct active_transaction *active;

528:   int result;
529: 
530:   active = busy_probe();

533:       active = &g_active;
534:     }
535: 
536:   if (!valid_ack_header(message, active))

538:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
539:       return;
540:     }

542:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
543:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
544:     {
545:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
546: 
547:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
548:       return;
549:     }
550: 
551:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
552:     {
553:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
554:       return;
555:     }
556: 
557:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
558:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
559: 
560:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
561:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
562:     {
563:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
564:     }
565: 
566:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
567:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
568:   if (replay)
569:     {
570:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
571:       unsigned int i;
572: 
573:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
574:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
575:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
576:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
577:        */
578: 
579:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
580:       g_active.quarantine = false;
581:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
582:         {
583:           if (i != replay_index)
584:             {
585:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
586:             }
587:         }
588: 
589:       select_recovery_epoch();
590:       (void)dispatch_locked();
591:       return;
592:     }
593: 
594:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
595: 
596:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
597:     {
598:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
599:         {
600:           release_recovery_slots();
601:           g_recovery_index = 0;
602:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
603:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
604:         }
605:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
606:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
607:         {
608:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
609:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
610:            */
611:         }
612:       else
613:         {
614:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
615:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
616:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
617:         }
618:     }
619: 
620:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
621:            result < 0)
622:     {
623:       begin_abort(result);
624:     }
625: 
626:   (void)dispatch_locked();

10: #include <string.h>

15: #include "arm_internal.h"
16: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
17: #include "hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h"
18: #include "irq.h"
19: 
20: #define MBOX_REG(n)             (BK7258_MBOX0_BASE + ((n) * 4u))
21: #define MBOX_CH1_CFG            MBOX_REG(0x20)
22: #define MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG       MBOX_REG(0x21)
23: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA0         MBOX_REG(0x22)
24: #define MBOX_CH1_TDATA1         MBOX_REG(0x23)
25: #define MBOX_CH1_TID            MBOX_REG(0x24)
26: #define MBOX_CH1_SID            MBOX_REG(0x25)
27: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA0         MBOX_REG(0x26)
28: #define MBOX_CH1_RDATA1         MBOX_REG(0x27)
29: #define MBOX_CH1_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x28)
30: #define MBOX_CH0_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x18)
31: #define MBOX_CH2_STATUS         MBOX_REG(0x38)
32: #define MBOX_CTRL               MBOX_REG(2)
33: 
34: #define MBOX_CFG_INT_EN         (1u << 8)
35: #define MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN       (1u << 9)
36: #define MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN       (1u << 10)
37: #define MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN      (1u << 11)
38: #define MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS   (1u << 16)
39: #define MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS   (1u << 17)
40: #define MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS  (1u << 18)
41: #define MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS   (MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS | \
42:                                  MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS | \
43:                                  MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS)
44: #define MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK        0x00000fffu
45: 
46: #define MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT      (2u * 3u + 1u)
47: 
48: struct mbox_rx_descriptor
49: {
50:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
51:   uint32_t order;
52:   bool used;
53: };
54: 
55: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
56: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor g_rx_desc[MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT];
57: static uint32_t g_rx_order;
58: static bool g_mbox_ready;
59: static struct bk7258_mbox_stats g_stats;
60: 
61: _Static_assert(MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT > 2u * 3u,
62:                "RX descriptors must hold a deferred command and two FIFOs");
63: 
64: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
65: {
66:   return getreg32(MBOX_CH1_STATUS);
67: }
68: 
69: static void mbox_clear_errors(void)
70: {
71:   uint32_t config = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_CFG);
72:   uint32_t errors = config & MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
73: 
74:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
75:     {
76:       g_stats.write_error++;
77:     }
78: 
79:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
80:     {
81:       g_stats.read_error++;
82:     }
83: 
84:   if ((errors & MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
85:     {
86:       g_stats.write_full++;
87:     }
88: 
89:   if (errors != 0)
90:     {
91:       putreg32((config & MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors, MBOX_CH1_CFG);
92:     }
93: }
94: 
95: static bool mbox_valid_envelope(uint8_t source, uint32_t address,
96:                                 uint32_t length)
97: {
98:   if (source != 0)
99:     {
100:       g_stats.bad_source++;
101:       return false;
102:     }
103: 
104:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
105:     {
106:       g_stats.bad_length++;
107:       return false;
108:     }
109: 
110:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
111:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
112:     {
113:       g_stats.bad_address++;
114:       return false;
115:     }
116: 
117:   return true;
118: }
119: 
120: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
121: {
122:   uintptr_t status;
123: 
124:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 2 || data == NULL)
125:     {
126:       return -EINVAL;
127:     }
128: 
129:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
130:    * receive FIFO status register.
131:    */
132: 
133:   status = destination == 0 ? MBOX_CH0_STATUS :
134:            destination == 1 ? MBOX_CH1_STATUS : MBOX_CH2_STATUS;
135:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
136:     {
137:       return -EAGAIN;
138:     }
139: 
140:   putreg32(data[0], MBOX_CH1_TDATA0);
141:   putreg32(data[1], MBOX_CH1_TDATA1);
142:   putreg32(destination, MBOX_CH1_TID);
143:   return OK;
144: }
145: 
146: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_alloc_desc(void)
147: {
148:   unsigned int i;
149: 
150:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
151:     {
152:       if (!g_rx_desc[i].used)
153:         {
154:           return &g_rx_desc[i];
155:         }
156:     }
157: 
158:   return NULL;
159: }
160: 
161: static bool mbox_priority_message(
162:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
163: {
164:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
165: 
166:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;
167: }
168: 
169: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
170: {
171:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
172:   unsigned int i;
173: 
174:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
175:     {
176:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
177: 
178:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
179:         {
180:           continue;
181:         }
182: 
183:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
184:         {
185:           oldest = desc;
186:         }
187:     }
188: 
189:   return oldest;
190: }
191: 
192: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
193: {
194:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
195:   int ret;
196: 
197:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
198:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
199:    */
200: 
201:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
202:     {
203:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
204:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
205:         {
206:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
207:           break;
208:         }
209: 
210:       desc->used = false;
211:     }
212: 
213:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
214:     {
215:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
216:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
217:         {
218:           break;
219:         }
220: 
221:       desc->used = false;
222:     }
223: }
224: 
225: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
226: {
227:   (void)irq;
228:   (void)context;
229:   (void)arg;
230: 
231:   mbox_clear_errors();
232: 
233:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0)
234:     {
235:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
236:       uint32_t address;
237:       uint32_t length;
238:       uint8_t source;
239: 
240:       mbox_process_desc();
241:       desc = mbox_alloc_desc();
242:       if (desc == NULL)
243:         {
244:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
245:           break;
246:         }
247: 
248:       source = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_SID) & 0x0fu;
249:       address = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA0);
250:       length = getreg32(MBOX_CH1_RDATA1);
251:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
252:         {
253:           continue;
254:         }
255: 
256:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
257:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
258:              sizeof(desc->message));
259:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
260:       desc->used = true;
261:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
262:       mbox_process_desc();
263:     }
264: 
265:   mbox_process_desc();
266: 
267:   return OK;
268: }
269: 
270: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)
271: {
272:   g_callback = callback;
273: }
274: 
275: void bk7258_mbox_get_stats(struct bk7258_mbox_stats *stats)
276: {
277:   irqstate_t flags;
278: 
279:   if (stats == NULL)
280:     {
281:       return;
282:     }
283: 
284:   flags = up_irq_save();
285:   *stats = g_stats;
286:   up_irq_restore(flags);
287: }
288: 
289: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
290: {
291:   int ret;
292: 
293:   if (g_mbox_ready)
294:     {
295:       return OK;
296:     }
297: 
298:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));
299:   g_rx_order = 0;
300:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
301: 
302:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
303:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
304:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
305:    */
306: 
307:   putreg32(2u | MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
308:            MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN, MBOX_CH1_CFG);
309:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
310:   modifyreg32(MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
311:   mbox_clear_errors();
312: 
313:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
314:   if (ret < 0)
315:     {
316:       return ret;
317:     }
318: 
319:   g_mbox_ready = true;
320:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
321:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
322:   return OK;
323: }

22: int bk7258_bringup(void)
23: {
24:   uint32_t button_count;
25:   int ret;
26: 
27:   button_count = board_button_initialize();
28: 
29:   ret = bk7258_motor_setup();
30:   if (ret < 0)
31:     {
32:       return ret;
33:     }
34: 
35:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_link_ready(1000);
36:   if (ret < 0)
37:     {
38:       printf("mailbox UART0 STATE probe failed, error=%d\n", ret);
39:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
40:       return ret;
41:     }
42: 
43:   printf("mailbox UART0 link ready\n");
44: 
45:   ret = bk7258_pwc_start();
46:   if (ret < 0)
47:     {
48:       return ret;
49:     }
50: 
51:   printf("button GPIOs configured, count=%lu\n",
52:          (unsigned long)button_count);
53:   printf("PWM device registered at /dev/pwm0\n");
54:   printf("mailbox transport, PWC and CPU1 ready handshake complete\n");
55:   printf("heartbeat worker started, interval=2000 ms\n");
56: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
57:   if (bk7258_psram_is_online())
58:     {
59:       printf("PSRAM online, base=0x60000000 size=0x01000000 "
60:              "RW/XN/non-cacheable\n");
61:       /* printf("PSRAM CP heap 0x60700000..0x6071ffff reserved\n"); */
62:       /* bk7258_psram_dump(); */
63:     }
64:   else
65:     {
66:       printf("PSRAM unavailable; media services must remain disabled\n");
67:     }
68: #endif
69: 
70:   ret = bk7258_power_key_motor_start();
71:   if (ret < 0)
72:     {
73:       return ret;
74:     }
75: 
76:   return 0;
77: }

104:    * the older bare board_late_initialize() smoke-test call this line used

106:    * kept as an independent NSH command (see bk7258_appinit.c) for

204: /****************************************************************************

210:  * Input Parameters:
211:  *   dev - Reference to the NuttX driver state structure
212:  *   pkt - The packets to transmit

219: static int beken_wlan_send(struct netdev_lowerhalf_s *dev, netpkt_t *pkt)
220: {
221:   static uint8_t tx_buf[2048];
222:   unsigned int len  = netpkt_getdatalen(dev, pkt);
223:   int rtn = 0;
224: 
225:   if (netpkt_is_fragmented(pkt))
226:     {
227:       netpkt_copyout(dev, tx_buf, pkt, len, 0);
228:       rtn = bk_wifi_send_tx_eth(tx_buf, len);
229:     }
230:   else
231:     {
232:       rtn = bk_wifi_send_tx_eth(netpkt_getdata(dev, pkt), len);
233:     }
234:   if (rtn > 0)
235:     {
236:       netpkt_free(dev, pkt, NETPKT_TX);
237:       return OK;
238:     }
239:   else
240:     {
241:       return -ENOMEM;
242:     }

99:   const uint8_t *src;
100:   uint8_t *dest;
101: 
102:   /* Enable CP10/CP11 before code compiled for the hard-float ABI can use the
103:    * floating-point extension.
104:    */
105: 
106:   modifyreg32(NVIC_CPACR, 0,
107:               NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(10) | NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(11));
108:   UP_DSB();
109:   UP_ISB();
110: 
111:   /* Match the current golden SPE SAU setup: the secure alias is retained,
112:    * while the 0x10000000 non-secure alias range is exposed as non-secure.
113:    */
114: 
115:   putreg32(0, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
116:   putreg32(0x00000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
117:   putreg32(0x0fffffe3u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
118:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x08);
119:   putreg32(0x10000000u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x0c);
120:   putreg32(0xefffffe1u, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x10);
121:   putreg32(1, BK7258_SAU_BASE + 0x00);
122:   UP_DSB();
123:   UP_ISB();
124: 
125:   for (src = _eronly, dest = _sdata; dest < _edata; )
126:     {
127:       *dest++ = *src++;
128:     }
129: 
130:   for (dest = _sbss; dest < _ebss; )
131:     {
132:       *dest++ = 0;
133:     }
134: 
135:   for (src = __ram_vectors_load, dest = __ram_vectors_start;
136:        dest < __ram_vectors_end; )
137:     {
138:       *dest++ = *src++;
139:     }
140: 
141:   putreg32((uintptr_t)__ram_vectors_start, NVIC_VECTAB);
142:   UP_DSB();
143:   UP_ISB();
144: 
145:   /* Install the buffered AP log channel before normal NuttX startup. */
146:   (void)bk7258_syslog_initialize();
147: 
148: #ifdef CONFIG_ARM_MPU
149:   {
150:     const size_t region_count = sizeof(g_bk7258_mpu_regions) /
151:                                 sizeof(g_bk7258_mpu_regions[0]);
152:     const uint32_t hardware_regions =
153:       (getreg32(MPU_TYPE) & MPU_TYPE_DREGION_MASK) >>
154:       MPU_TYPE_DREGION_SHIFT;
155: 
156:     if (hardware_regions < region_count)
157:       {
158:         /* A missing shared-memory region would silently widen privileged
159:          * access through PRIVDEFENA.  Refuse to boot rather than claim
160:          * permissions that the hardware did not install.
161:          */
162: 
163:         syslog(LOG_ERR, "BK7258 MPU has %lu regions, needs %zu\n",
164:                (unsigned long)hardware_regions, region_count);
165:         for (; ; )
166:           {
167:           }
168:       }
169: 
170:     syslog(LOG_INFO, "BK7258 MPU regions=%zu/%lu, shared RX RO TX RW\n",
171:            region_count, (unsigned long)hardware_regions);
172:     mpu_reset();
173:     mpu_initialize(g_bk7258_mpu_regions, region_count, false, true);
174:   }
175: #endif
176: 
177: #ifdef USE_EARLYSERIALINIT
178:   arm_earlyserialinit();
179: #endif

181:   nx_start();

184:     }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 PWC worker and CPU1 ready handshake.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: #include <stdint.h>
7: #include <stdbool.h>
8: #include <stdio.h>
9: 
10: #include <nuttx/semaphore.h>
11: #include <nuttx/sched.h>
12: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
13: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
14: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
15: 
16: #include "bk7258_psram.h"
17: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
18: 
19: #define PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD 0x5u
20: #define PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD 0x7u
21: #define PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD 0x8u
22: #define PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD 0x9u
23: #define PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD 0xau
24: #define PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1 11u
25: #define PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON 0u
26: #define PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF 1u
27: #define PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT 0u
28: #define PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH 1u
29: #define PM_QUEUE_DEPTH 8u
30: #define PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS 500u
31: #define PM_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS 1000u
32: 
33: struct pwc_message
34: {
35:   uint32_t header;
36:   uint32_t param1;
37:   uint32_t param2;
38:   uint32_t param3;
39: };
40: 
41: static struct pwc_message g_queue[PM_QUEUE_DEPTH];
42: static volatile unsigned int g_head;
43: static volatile unsigned int g_tail;
44: static sem_t g_pwc_sem;
45: static sem_t g_worker_sem;
46: static sem_t g_psram_power_sem;
47: static volatile bool g_worker_ready;
48: static volatile bool g_ready_sent;
49: static volatile bool g_psram_power_waiting;
50: static volatile uint32_t g_psram_power_state;
51: 
52: static void psram_power_vote_rollback(void)
53: {
54:   int ret;
55: 
56:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD,
57:                                 PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
58:                                 PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF, 0);
59:   if (ret >= 0)
60:     {
61:       ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_pwc(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
62:     }
63: 
64:   if (ret < 0)
65:     {
66:       printf("PWC: PSRAM power vote rollback failed, error=%d\n", ret);
67:     }
68: }
69: 
70: static int ipc_heartbeat_worker(int argc, char **argv)
71: {
72:   static uint32_t heartbeat_payload;
73: 
74:   (void)argc;
75:   (void)argv;
76:   for (;;)
77:     {
78:       nxsig_usleep(2000000);
79:       (void)bk7258_mbox_send_message(2, 0x10,
80:                                      (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)&heartbeat_payload,
81:                                      sizeof(heartbeat_payload), 0);
82:     }
83:   return 0;
84: }
85: 
86: static void pwc_rx(const void *raw)
87: {
88:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
89:   struct pwc_message message;
90:   unsigned int next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
91:   if (next == g_tail || bytes == NULL)
92:     {
93:       return;
94:     }
95:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
96:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
97:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
98:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
99:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
100:   g_head = next;
101:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
102: }
103: 
104: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
105: {
106:   (void)argc;
107:   (void)argv;
108:   g_worker_ready = true;
109:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);
110:   for (;;)
111:     {
112:       struct pwc_message message;
113:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
114:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
115:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
116:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
117:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
118:         {
119:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
120:             /* The unmodified AVDK SMP firmware returns the requested ON/OFF
121:              * state in param1. It does not expose the PSRAM driver result or
122:              * detected capacity, so AP validates its configured regions with
123:              * the non-destructive boundary probe before creating allocators.
124:              */
125: 
126:             g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
127:             if (g_psram_power_waiting)
128:               {
129:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
130:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
131:               }
132:             break;
133: 
134: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
135:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
136:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
137:               {
138:                 (void)bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
139:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
140:                   PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
141:                   bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
142:               }
143:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
144:               {
145:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
146: 
147:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
148:               }
149:             break;
150: 
151:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
152:             bk7258_psram_dump();
153:             break;
154: 
155:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
156:             {
157:               int ret = bk7258_psram_shutdown();
158: 
159:               (void)bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(
160:                 PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
161:                 ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
162:                            PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT, 0);
163:             }
164:             break;
165: #endif
166: 
167:           default:
168:             break;
169:         }
170:     }
171:   return 0;
172: }
173: 
174: int bk7258_pwc_start(void)
175: {
176:   int pid;
177:   int ret;
178: 
179:   nxsem_init(&g_pwc_sem, 0, 0);
180:   nxsem_init(&g_worker_sem, 0, 0);
181:   nxsem_init(&g_psram_power_sem, 0, 0);
182:   g_head = 0;
183:   g_tail = 0;
184:   g_worker_ready = false;
185:   g_ready_sent = false;
186:   g_psram_power_waiting = false;
187:   g_psram_power_state = PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF;
188:   bk7258_mailbox_set_pwc_rx(pwc_rx);
189:   /* Match Armino mb_ipc_heartbeat: notify CPU0 before PM ready and keep the
190:    * CPU1 liveness indication independent from the PWC worker. */
191:   if (bk7258_mbox_send_message(1, 0x10, 0, 0, 0) != 0)
192:     {
193:       return -1;
194:     }
195: 
196:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_hw_control(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
197:   if (ret < 0)
198:     {
199:       printf("PWC: IPC power-up transport timeout, error=%d\n", ret);
200:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
201:       return ret;
202:     }
203:   printf("PWC: IPC power-up transport complete\n");
204: 
205:   if (kthread_create("ipc-heartbeat", 100, 1536, ipc_heartbeat_worker,
206:                      NULL) < 0)
207:     {
208:       return -1;
209:     }
210:   pid = kthread_create("pwc", 110, 2048, pwc_worker, NULL);
211:   if (pid < 0)
212:     {
213:       return pid;
214:     }
215:   if (nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_worker_sem, MSEC2TICK(200)) < 0 ||
216:       !g_worker_ready)
217:     {
218:       printf("PWC: worker start timeout\n");
219:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
220:       return -ETIMEDOUT;
221:     }
222:   printf("PWC: worker ready\n");
223: 
224:   /* CP boots CPU1 from its low-power worker and waits there for this ready
225:    * command. Send it before requesting PSRAM, whose vote is handled by that
226:    * same worker, otherwise the two cores deadlock waiting for each other.
227:    */
228: 
229:   g_ready_sent = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CPU1_BOOT_READY_CMD,
230:                                          1, 0, 0) == 0;
231:   if (!g_ready_sent)
232:     {
233:       printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready queue failed\n");
234:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
235:       return -EIO;
236:     }
237: 
238:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_pwc(PM_TRANSPORT_TIMEOUT_MS);
239:   if (ret < 0)
240:     {
241:       printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready transport timeout, error=%d\n", ret);
242:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
243:       return ret;
244:     }
245: 
246:   printf("PWC: CPU1 boot-ready acknowledged by CP transport\n");
247: 
248: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
249:   g_psram_power_waiting = true;
250:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_pwc(PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD,
251:                                 PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
252:                                 PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON, 0);
253:   if (ret >= 0)
254:     {
255:       ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_psram_power_sem,
256:                          MSEC2TICK(PM_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS));
257:     }
258: 
259:   g_psram_power_waiting = false;
260:   if (ret < 0 || g_psram_power_state != PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_ON)
261:     {
262:       printf("PWC: PSRAM power response failed, error=%d state=%lu\n",
263:              ret, (unsigned long)g_psram_power_state);
264:       bk7258_mailbox_dump_stats();
265:       psram_power_vote_rollback();
266: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_REQUIRED
267:       return ret < 0 ? ret : -EIO;
268: #endif
269:     }
270:   else
271:     {
272:       /* printf("PWC: PSRAM power vote ON acknowledged\n"); */
273:       ret = bk7258_psram_initialize();
274:       if (ret < 0)
275:         {
276:           printf("PWC: PSRAM allocator initialization failed, error=%d\n",
277:                  ret);
278:           psram_power_vote_rollback();
279: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM_REQUIRED
280:           return ret;
281: #endif
282:         }
283:       else
284:         {
285:           /* printf("PWC: PSRAM allocators ONLINE\n"); */
286:         }
287:     }
288: #endif
289: 
290:   if (g_ready_sent)
291:     {
292:       return 0;
293:     }
294: 
295:   return -1;
296: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 full-duplex mailbox UART0.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <stdio.h>
11: #include <string.h>
12: 
13: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
14: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
15: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
16: #include <nuttx/semaphore.h>
17: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
18: 
19: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
20: 
21: #ifndef CONFIG_BK7258_MB_UART0_TXBUFSIZE
22: #  define CONFIG_BK7258_MB_UART0_TXBUFSIZE 8192
23: #endif
24: 
25: #ifndef CONFIG_BK7258_MB_UART0_RXBUFSIZE
26: #  define CONFIG_BK7258_MB_UART0_RXBUFSIZE 256
27: #endif
28: 
29: #define MB_UART_TX_SIZE       CONFIG_BK7258_MB_UART0_TXBUFSIZE
30: #define MB_UART_RX_CAPACITY   CONFIG_BK7258_MB_UART0_RXBUFSIZE
31: #define MB_UART_RX_SIZE       (MB_UART_RX_CAPACITY + 1u)
32: #define MB_UART_RTS_ASSERT    BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE
33: #define MB_UART_RTS_RELEASE   ((MB_UART_RX_CAPACITY * 40u) / 100u)
34: #define MB_UART_WORK_INTERVAL MSEC2TICK(10)
35: #define MB_UART_STATUS_OVF    0x01u
36: #define MB_UART_STATUS_PARITY 0x02u
37: 
38: struct mb_uart_stats
39: {
40:   uint32_t write_calls;
41:   uint32_t write_bytes;
42:   uint32_t short_writes;
43:   uint32_t data_tx;
44:   uint32_t data_rx;
45:   uint32_t state_tx;
46:   uint32_t state_rx;
47:   uint32_t rx_bytes;
48:   uint32_t rx_overflow;
49:   uint32_t bad_pointer;
50:   uint32_t bad_length;
51:   uint32_t bad_flags;
52:   uint32_t bad_crc;
53:   uint32_t bad_reserved;
54:   uint32_t remote_fail;
55:   uint32_t tx_retry;
56:   uint32_t tx_retry_drop;
57:   uint32_t tx_unknown;
58:   uint32_t resets;
59:   uint32_t rts_assert;
60:   uint32_t rts_release;
61: };
62: 
63: struct mb_uart_control
64: {
65:   uint8_t tx_ring[MB_UART_TX_SIZE];
66:   uint8_t rx_ring[MB_UART_RX_SIZE];
67:   uint16_t tx_read;
68:   uint16_t tx_write;
69:   uint16_t rx_read;
70:   uint16_t rx_write;
71:   uint16_t tx_inflight;
72:   uint8_t tx_retry_count;
73:   uint8_t sticky_status;
74:   bool initialized;
75:   bool transaction_busy;
76:   uint8_t transaction_command;
77:   bool state_pending;
78:   bool local_rts;
79:   bool upper_rts;
80:   bool peer_rts;
81:   bool peer_rts_known;
82:   sem_t worker_sem;
83:   bk7258_mb_uart_callback_t callback;
84:   void *callback_arg;
85:   struct mb_uart_stats stats;
86: };
87: 
88: static struct mb_uart_control g_uart;
89: 
90: _Static_assert(MB_UART_TX_SIZE > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE &&
91:                MB_UART_TX_SIZE <= UINT16_MAX,
92:                "mailbox UART TX ring index does not fit uint16_t");
93: _Static_assert(MB_UART_RX_SIZE > BK7258_MB_UART_CHUNK_SIZE &&
94:                MB_UART_RX_SIZE <= UINT16_MAX,
95:                "mailbox UART RX ring index does not fit uint16_t");
96: 
97: static uint16_t ring_count(uint16_t read_index, uint16_t write_index,
98:                            uint16_t size)
99: {
100:   return write_index >= read_index ? write_index - read_index :
101:          size - read_index + write_index;
102: }
103: 
104: static uint16_t tx_count(void)
105: {
106:   return ring_count(g_uart.tx_read, g_uart.tx_write, MB_UART_TX_SIZE);
107: }
108: 
109: static uint16_t rx_count(void)
110: {
111:   return ring_count(g_uart.rx_read, g_uart.rx_write, MB_UART_RX_SIZE);
112: }
113: 
114: static uint16_t tx_free(void)
115: {
116:   return MB_UART_TX_SIZE - tx_count() - 1u;
117: }
118: 
119: static uint16_t rx_free(void)
120: {
121:   return MB_UART_RX_CAPACITY - rx_count();
122: }
123: 
124: static void update_local_rts(void)
125: {
126:   bool new_rts = g_uart.upper_rts || rx_free() <= MB_UART_RTS_ASSERT;
127: 
128:   if (new_rts != g_uart.local_rts)
129:     {
130:       g_uart.local_rts = new_rts;
131:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
132:       if (new_rts)
133:         {
134:           g_uart.stats.rts_assert++;
135:         }
136:       else
137:         {
138:           g_uart.stats.rts_release++;
139:         }
140:     }
141: }
142: 
143: static bool valid_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack)
144: {
145:   return ack != NULL && (ack->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
146:          ack->payload_length == 0 && ack->flags == 0 && ack->crc8 == 0 &&
147:          ack->reserved == 0;
148: }
149: 
150: static void mb_uart_tx_complete(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
151:                                 int result, void *arg)
152: {
153:   irqstate_t flags;
154:   uint8_t command;
155:   bool failed;
156: 
157:   (void)arg;
158:   flags = up_irq_save();
159:   command = ack == NULL ? g_uart.transaction_command :
160:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(ack);
161:   failed = result < 0 || !valid_ack(ack) ||
162:            (ack != NULL && (ack->payload_address & 2u) != 0);
163: 
164:   if (ack != NULL && valid_ack(ack))
165:     {
166:       g_uart.peer_rts = (ack->payload_address & 1u) != 0;
167:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = true;
168:     }
169: 
170:   if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)
171:     {
172:       g_uart.peer_rts_known = false;
173:       g_uart.state_pending = true;
174:     }
175: 
176:   if (command == BK7258_MB_UART_DATA && g_uart.tx_inflight != 0)
177:     {
178:       if (!failed)
179:         {
180:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
181:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
182:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
183:         }
184:       else if (result == -ETIMEDOUT || result == -ECONNRESET)
185:         {
186:           /* A failed/unknown ACK cannot tell whether CP consumed the bytes.
187:            * Drop this local chunk rather than replaying terminal characters.
188:            */
189: 
190:           g_uart.tx_read = (g_uart.tx_read + g_uart.tx_inflight) %
191:                            MB_UART_TX_SIZE;
192:           g_uart.stats.tx_unknown++;
193:           g_uart.tx_retry_count = 0;
194:           g_uart.stats.resets++;

57:  *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
58:  */

183: static inline bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send_safe(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
184: {

194: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
195: {
196: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
197: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
198: 	u16 			chnl_type;
199: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
200: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
201: 
202: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
203: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
204: 
205: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
206: 		return 4;
207: 
208: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
209: 		return 5;
210: 
211: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
212: 		return 3;
213: 
214: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
215: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
216: 
217: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
218: 		return 1;
219: 
220: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
221: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
222: 
223: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
224: 
225: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
226: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
227: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
228: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
229: 
230: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
231: 
232: 	__DMB();
233: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
234: 
235: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
236: 
237: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
238: 
239: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
240: 	{
241: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
242: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
243: 
244: 		return 2;
245: 	}
246: 
247: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
248: 
249: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
250: 
251: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
252: 	{
253: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
254: 	}
255: 
256: 	return 0;
257: }

259: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
260: {
261: 	u8		log_chnl;
262: 	u8		ret_code;
263: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
264: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
265: 
266: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
267: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
268: 
269: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
270: 
271: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
272: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
273: 
274: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
275: 
276: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
277: 		return;
278: 
279: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
280: 		return;
281: 
282: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
283: 		return;
284: 
285: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
286: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
287: 
288: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
289: 		return;
290: 
291: 	if( (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
292: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) )
293: 	{
294: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
295: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
296: 
297: 		/* Stale / mismatched ACK. The original implementation just
298: 		 * returned here, which left phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state stuck at
299: 		 * BUSY forever and deadlocked all subsequent mb_chnl_write()
300: 		 * on this physical channel. Recover the channel and re-dispatch
301: 		 * any pending logical-channel tx so we don't lose the link. */
302: 		{
303: 			u32 int_mask_stale = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
304: 			u8  i;
305: 
306: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
307: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
308: 
309: 			for (i = 0; i < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; i++) {
310: 				if (log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE) {
311: 					u8 pending = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + i;
312: 					phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
313: 					phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
314: 					if (mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(pending) != 0) {
315: 						log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state   = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
316: 						phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
317: 						phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
318: 					}
319: 					break;
320: 				}
321: 			}
322: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask_stale);
323: 		}
324: 		return;
325: 	}
326: 
327: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
328: 	{
329: 		/* clear following header members. */
330: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
331: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
332: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
333: 
334: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
335: 
336: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
337: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
338: 	}
339: 
340: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
341: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
342: 	{
343: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
344: 			break;
345: 	}
346: 
347: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
348: 	{
349: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
350: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
351: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
352: 		return;
353: 	}
354: 
355: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
356: 
357: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
358: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
359: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
360: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
361: 
362: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
363: 
364: 	if(ret_code != 0)
365: 	{
366: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
367: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
368: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
369: 	}
370: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
371: 
372: 	return;
373: 
374: }

376: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
377: {
378: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
379: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
380: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
381: 	u16 		chnl_type;
382: 
383: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
384: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
385: 
386: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
387: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
388: 
389: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
390: 
391: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
392: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
393: 
394: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
395: 		return;
396: 
397: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
398: 		return;
399: 
400: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
401: 		return;
402: 
403: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
404: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
405: 
406: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
407: 
408: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
409: 	{
410: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
411: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
412: 
413: 		return;
414: 	}
415: 
416: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
417: 	{
418: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
419: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
420: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
421: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
422: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
423: 
424: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
425: 
426: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
427: 	}
428: 	else
429: 	{
430: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
431: 	}
432: 
433: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
434: 	{
435: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
436: 		return;
437: 	}
438: 
439: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
440: 
441: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
442: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
443: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
444: 
445: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
446: 
447: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
448: 
449: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
450: 
451: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
452: 	{
453: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
454: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
455: 
456: 		return;
457: 	}
458: 	s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
459: 	return;
460: }
461: 
462: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
463: {
464: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
465: 
466: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
467: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
468: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
469: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
470: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
471: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
472: 
473: 	/*
474: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
475: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
476: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
477: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
478: 	 */
479: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
480: 	{
481: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
482: 	}
483: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
484: 	{
485: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
486: 	}
487: }

489: static void mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
490: {
491: 	u8		ret_code;
492: 
493: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
494: 
495: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
496: 
497: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
498: 
499: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
500: 		return;
501: 
502: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
503: 		return;
504: 
505: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
506: 
507: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
508: 	{
509: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
510: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
511: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
512: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
513: 
514: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
515: 
516: 		if(ret_code != 0)
517: 		{
518: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
519: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
520: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
521: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
522: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
523: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
524: 
525: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
526: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
527: 			}
528: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
529: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
530: 		}
531: 	}
532: 
533: 	return;
534: }

536: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
537: 
538: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
539: {
540: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
541: 	u16 			chnl_type;
542: 
543: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
544: 
545: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
546: 
547: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
548: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
549: 
550: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
551: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
552: 
553: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
554: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
555: 
556: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
557: 
558: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
559: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
560: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
561: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
562: 
563: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
564: 
565: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
566: 
567: 	/*
568: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
569: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
570: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
571: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
572: 	 */
573: 	while(1)
574: 	{
575: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
576: 
577: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
578: 		{
579: 			break;
580: 		}
581: 	}
582: 
583: 	return ret_code;
584: }

607: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
608: /*
609:   * init logical chnanel module.
610:   * return:
611:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
612:   *     failed  : fail code.
613:   *
614:   */
615: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
616: {
617: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
618: 	int				i, j;
619: 
620: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
621: 
622: 	/*
623: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
624: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
625: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
626: 	 * can race here:
627: 	 *
628: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
629: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
630: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
631: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
632: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
633: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
634: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
635: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
636: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
637: 	 *
638: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
639: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
640: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
641: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
642: 	 */
643: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
644: 	{
645: 		return BK_OK;
646: 	}
647: 
648: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
649: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
650: 	{
651: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
652: 		return BK_OK;
653: 	}
654: 
655: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
656: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
657: 	{
658: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
659: 
660: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
661: 
662: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
663: 
664: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
665: 		{
666: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
667: 		}
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
671: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
672: 	{
673: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
674: 		return ret_code;
675: 	}
676: 
677: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
678: 
679: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
680: 	{
681: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
682: 
683: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
684: 	}
685: 
686: 	mb_phy_chnl_reset(0);
687: 
688: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
689: 
690: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
691: 
692: 	return BK_OK;
693: }

695: /*
696:   * open logical chnanel.
697:   * input:
698:   *     log_chnl  : logical channel id to open.
699:   *     callback_param : param passsed to all callbacks.
700:   * return:
701:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
702:   *     failed  : fail code.
703:   *
704:   */
705: bk_err_t mb_chnl_open(u8 log_chnl, void * callback_param)
706: {
707: 	if(!mb_chnnl_init_ok)	/* if driver is not initialized. */
708: 	{
709: 		bk_err_t		ret_code;
710: 
711: 		ret_code = mb_chnl_init();
712: 
713: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
714: 		{
715: 			return ret_code;
716: 		}
717: 	}
718: 
719: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
720: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
721: 
722: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
723: 
724: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
725: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
726: 
727: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
728: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
729: 
730: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
731: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
732: 
733: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
734: 
735: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
736: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
737: 
738: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used)
739: 		return BK_ERR_OPEN;
740: 
741: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used = 1;		/* chnl in used. */
742: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param = callback_param;
743: 
744: 	return BK_OK;
745: }

747: /*
748:   * close logical chnanel.
749:   * input:
750:   *     log_chnl  : logical channel id to close.
751:   * return:
752:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
753:   *     failed  : fail code.
754:   *
755:   */
756: bk_err_t mb_chnl_close(u8 log_chnl)
757: {

759: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
760: 
761: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
762: 
763: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
764: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
765: 
766: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
767: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
768: 
769: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
770: 
771: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])

780: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr = NULL;

787:   * read from logical chnanel.
788:   * input:
789:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to read.
790:   *     read_buf       : buffer to receive channel cmd data.

792:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
793:   *     failed  : fail code.

795:   */
796: bk_err_t mb_chnl_read(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * read_buf)

801: /*
802:   * write to logical chnanel.
803:   * input:
804:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
805:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.
806:   * return:
807:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
808:   *     failed  : fail code.
809:   *
810:   */
811: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
812: {
813: 	u16		write_len;
814: 
815: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
816: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
817: 
818: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
819: 
820: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
821: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
822: 
823: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
824: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
825: 
826: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
827: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
828: 
829: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
830: 
831: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
832: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
833: 
834: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
835: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
836: 
837: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
838: 
839: 	/* If the physical channel has been BUSY abnormally long (peer never
840: 	 * sent ACK / lost interrupt / lost ack), forcibly recover it so this
841: 	 * and all future mb_chnl_write() calls on the channel don't deadlock. */
842: 	{
843: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy_cb_chk = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
844: 
845: 		if ((phy_cb_chk->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY) && (phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms != 0))
846: 		{
847: 			u32 now = rtos_get_time();
848: 			u32 age = now - phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms;	/* unsigned wrap is fine for short windows */
849: 
850: 			if (age >= MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS)
851: 			{
852: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_fault_cnt++;
853: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x20000000;	/* mark "BUSY-stuck recovered" */
854: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
855: 				phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms = 0;
856: 			}
857: 		}
858: 	}
859: 
860: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
861: 	{
862: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
863: 
864: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
865: 	}
866: 
867: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
868: 
869: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
870: 
871: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
872: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
873: 	__DMB();
874: 
875: 	mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
876: 
877: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
878: 
879: 	return BK_OK;
880: }

883:   * logical chnanel misc io (set/get param).

893: bk_err_t mb_chnl_ctrl(u8 log_chnl, u8 cmd, void * param)

895: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;

897: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
898: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
899: 
900: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
901: 
902: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
903: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
904: 
905: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
906: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
907: 
908: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
909: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
910: 
911: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
912: 
913: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])

916: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
917: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
918: 
919: 	switch(cmd)
920: 	{
921: 		case MB_CHNL_GET_STATUS:
922: 
923: 			if(param == NULL)
924: 				return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;

928: 			break;

931: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr = (chnl_rx_isr_t)param;
932: 			break;
933: 
934: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_ISR:
935: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr = (chnl_tx_isr_t)param;
936: 			break;
937: 
938: 		case MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR:
939: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr = (chnl_tx_cmpl_isr_t)param;
940: 			break;
941:

947: 			return ret_code;
948: 			break;
949: 
950: 		default:
951: 			return BK_ERR_NOT_SUPPORT;
952: 			break;
953: 	}

31:  * without seeing the matching ACK from the peer CPU, mb_chnl_write() will
32:  * forcibly recover it. Normal mailbox round-trips are << 1 ms, so 200 ms
33:  * is well clear of any legitimate burst while still keeping the system
34:  * responsive in the unlikely event the peer never replies. */

39: typedef struct

42: 	u8		tx_seq;				/* physical channel tx sequence. */
43: 	u8		tx_log_chnl;		/* logical channel. */ /* bit7~bit4: dst/src CPU_ID, bit3~bit0: log_chnl_idx. */
44: 	u8		tx_hdr_cmd;

52: 	 * CHNL_STATE_BUSY. Used by mb_chnl_write() to detect a physical
53: 	 * channel that has been BUSY abnormally long (peer lost / dropped
54: 	 * the ACK) and forcibly clear it. 0 means "channel is IDLE". */
55: 	volatile u32	busy_since_ms;
56: 	u8		recovering;
57: 	u32		ack_retry_cnt;

209: static inline bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send_safe(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
210: {

212: 
213: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();

220: static bool mb_chnl_rx_ready(void)
221: {

223: }

225: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
226: {
227: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
228: 
229: 	while (1)
230: 	{
231: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
232: 		bk_err_t ret;
233: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
234: 
235: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
236: 		{
237: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
238: 			return;
239: 		}
240: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
241: 		ack_sending = 1;
242: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
243: 
244: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
245: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
246: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
247: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
248: 		{
249: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
250: 			ack_sending = 0;
251: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
252: 			return;
253: 		}
254: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
255: 		ack_count--;
256: 		ack_sending = 0;
257: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
258: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
259: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
260: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],
261: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
262: 	}
263: }

265: static bool mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(u8 destination, const mailbox_data_t *data)
266: {
267: 	u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
268: 	mb_ack_entry_t *entry;
269: 
270: 	if (ack_count >= MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN)
271: 	{
272: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[destination].ack_queue_full_cnt++;
273: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
274: 		return false;
275: 	}
276: 	entry = &ack_queue[ack_write];
277: 	entry->data = *data;
278: 	entry->destination = destination;
279: 	ack_write = (ack_write + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
280: 	ack_count++;
281: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
282: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
283: 	return true;
284: }

329: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
330: {
331: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
332: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
333: 	u16 			chnl_type;
334: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
335: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
336: 
337: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
338: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
339: 
340: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
341: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
342: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
343: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
344: #endif
345: 
346: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
347: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
348: 
349: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
350: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
351: 
352: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
353: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
354: 
355: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
356: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
357: 
358: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
359: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
360: 
361: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
362: 
363: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
364: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
365: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
366: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
367: 
368: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
369: 
370: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
371: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
372: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
373: 
374: 	__DMB();
375: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
376: 
377: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
378: 
379: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
380: 
381: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
382: 	{
383: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
384: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
385: 
386: 		return ret_code;
387: 	}
388: 
389: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
390: 
391: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
392: 
393: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
394: 	{
395: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
396: 	}
397: 
398: 	return BK_OK;
399: }
